what: Gatlion's Galaxy (Godot 4.7.2, GL Compatibility, web no-threads export). High-on-Life style first-person shooter: two talking guns (Gatlion the gatling-lion, Squibby the goo pistol), talking aliens (Grubbo, Spitzer, Bonkhead), Zib the bounty officer and the boss Kingpin Glorp. All meshes are built in code. Voices: tools/make_voices.py speaks every line with espeak-ng + MBROLA (apt: espeak-ng mbrola mbrola-us1 mbrola-us2 mbrola-us3) and gives each character its own effect chain -> assets/voice/*.ogg + lines.json. SFX + music: tools/make_sfx.py (numpy + ffmpeg). Icon: tools/make_icon.py. Fonts: @fontsource luckiest-guy 400 and fredoka 700 woff2 -> assets/fonts/luckiest.woff2, fredoka.woff2. Build: godot --headless --path . --import; godot --headless --path . -- --selftest (full automated playthrough); bash tools/export.sh. Debug URL hashes: #auto (start at once), #warp0/#warp1/#warp2 (jump to an area). Publish all files in ../build to the same artifact URL.

extends CharacterBody3D
# Goo Gang aliens. grubbo = small hopping biter, spitzer = ranged spitter, bonkhead = big charging brute.
# Every alien talks: a 3D voice clip, a speech bubble, and a mouth that moves with the words.

signal died(alien)

var kind := "grubbo"
var main: Node
var player: Node3D
var hp := 40.0
var max_hp := 40.0
var speed := 5.0
var big := false
var alive := true
var body: Node3D
var mouth: MeshInstance3D
var meshes: Array[MeshInstance3D] = []
var bubble: Label3D
var voice: AudioStreamPlayer3D
var bark_id := ""
var bark_t := 0.0
var bark_len := 0.0
var spawn_t := 0.7
var attack_cd := 1.5
var state := "chase"
var state_t := 0.0
var knock := Vector3.ZERO
var flash := 0.0
var hop_t := 0.0
var strafe := 1.0
var strafe_t := 0.0
var charge_dir := Vector3.ZERO
var spotted := false
var taunt_t := 0.0
var radius := 0.6
var head_h := 1.0
var hurt_mat: StandardMaterial3D

const GRAVITY := 19.0

func setup(k: String) -> void:
	kind = k
	collision_layer = G.LAYER_ENEMY
	collision_mask = G.LAYER_WORLD
	body = Node3D.new()
	add_child(body)
	var shape := CollisionShape3D.new()
	var cap := CapsuleShape3D.new()
	match kind:
		"grubbo":
			hp = 45; speed = 5.5; radius = 0.6; head_h = 1.0
			cap.radius = 0.6; cap.height = 1.3
			_build_grubbo()
		"spitzer":
			hp = 70; speed = 4.5; radius = 0.55; head_h = 2.2
			cap.radius = 0.55; cap.height = 2.5
			_build_spitzer()
		"bonkhead":
			hp = 240; speed = 3.2; radius = 1.2; head_h = 2.6; big = true
			cap.radius = 1.2; cap.height = 3.0
			_build_bonkhead()
	max_hp = hp
	G.part(self, G.cyl(radius * 1.1, radius * 1.1, 0.02, 16), G.flat(Color(0, 0, 0, 0.3)), Vector3(0, 0.04, 0))
	shape.shape = cap
	shape.position.y = cap.height * 0.5
	add_child(shape)
	bubble = Label3D.new()
	bubble.billboard = BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_ENABLED
	bubble.font = G.font_body
	bubble.font_size = 40
	bubble.pixel_size = 0.0011
	bubble.fixed_size = true
	bubble.outline_size = 18
	bubble.modulate = G.SPEAKER_COLOR[kind.to_upper()]
	bubble.outline_modulate = Color(0.1, 0.02, 0.15)
	bubble.no_depth_test = true
	bubble.position.y = head_h + 0.9
	bubble.width = 900
	bubble.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	bubble.visible = false
	add_child(bubble)
	voice = AudioStreamPlayer3D.new()
	voice.unit_size = 12.0
	voice.max_db = 6.0
	voice.volume_db = 4.0
	voice.position.y = head_h
	add_child(voice)
	hurt_mat = G.flat(Color(1, 1, 1, 0.65))
	strafe = 1.0 if G.rng.randf() < 0.5 else -1.0
	attack_cd = G.rng.randf_range(1.0, 2.0)
	body.scale = Vector3.ONE * 0.01

func _m(mesh: Mesh, c: Color, pos: Vector3, scl := Vector3.ONE, rot := Vector3.ZERO, parent: Node3D = null) -> MeshInstance3D:
	var mi := G.part(parent if parent else body, mesh, G.mat(c, 0.05, true), pos, scl, rot)
	meshes.append(mi)
	return mi

func _mouth(parent: Node3D, pos: Vector3, w: float) -> void:
	mouth = G.part(parent, G.sphere(0.5, 12), G.flat(Color(0.3, 0.02, 0.12)), pos, Vector3(w, w * 0.15, w * 0.4))

func _build_grubbo() -> void:
	var c := Color(0.45, 0.95, 0.3)
	_m(G.sphere(0.6, 18), c, Vector3(0, 0.6, 0), Vector3(1, 0.88, 1))
	_m(G.sphere(0.3, 10), c.lightened(0.3), Vector3(0, 0.28, -0.25), Vector3(1.4, 0.5, 1))
	for x in [-0.22, 0.22]:
		var stalk := _m(G.cyl(0.04, 0.06, 0.45, 6), c, Vector3(x, 1.2, -0.1), Vector3.ONE, Vector3(-0.3, 0, -x))
		var e := Node3D.new()
		e.position = Vector3(0, 0.3, 0)
		stalk.add_child(e)
		G.eye(e, Vector3.ZERO, 0.14)
	_mouth(body, Vector3(0, 0.55, -0.56), 0.5)
	for i in 3:
		_m(G.sphere(0.08, 6), Color(0.2, 0.6, 0.15), Vector3(-0.3 + i * 0.3, 0.95, 0.35))

func _build_spitzer() -> void:
	var c := Color(0.68, 0.35, 0.95)
	_m(G.sphere(0.55, 16), c, Vector3(0, 0.75, 0), Vector3(1, 1.4, 1))
	var neck := _m(G.cyl(0.18, 0.28, 0.8, 10), c, Vector3(0, 1.75, 0))
	var head := Node3D.new()
	head.position = Vector3(0, 2.25, 0)
	body.add_child(head)
	_m(G.sphere(0.45, 16), c.lightened(0.15), Vector3.ZERO, Vector3(1, 0.85, 1.1), Vector3.ZERO, head)
	G.eye(head, Vector3(0, 0.15, -0.32), 0.22)
	_m(G.cyl(0.12, 0.2, 0.35, 10), c.darkened(0.2), Vector3(0, -0.12, -0.45), Vector3.ONE, Vector3(-PI / 2, 0, 0), head)
	_mouth(head, Vector3(0, -0.12, -0.63), 0.24)
	for i in 4:
		_m(G.cyl(0.0, 0.08, 0.25, 6), Color(1.0, 0.8, 0.2), Vector3(0, 0.3 - i * 0.05, 0.25 + i * 0.12), Vector3.ONE, Vector3(-0.8, 0, 0), head)
	neck.rotation.x = -0.15

func _build_bonkhead() -> void:
	var c := Color(1.0, 0.55, 0.2)
	_m(G.sphere(1.1, 20), c, Vector3(0, 1.3, 0), Vector3(1.15, 1.0, 1.0))
	_m(G.sphere(0.6, 12), c.darkened(0.15), Vector3(0, 0.55, -0.55), Vector3(1.4, 0.7, 0.8))
	for x in [-1.0, 1.0]:
		_m(G.cyl(0.0, 0.22, 0.8, 8), Color(1, 0.95, 0.8), Vector3(x * 0.7, 2.3, -0.2), Vector3.ONE, Vector3(-0.3, 0, -x * 0.6))
		_m(G.sphere(0.4, 12), c, Vector3(x * 1.35, 1.0, -0.3), Vector3(1, 1.3, 1))
		G.eye(body, Vector3(x * 0.38, 1.85, -0.88), 0.18)
		_m(G.box(Vector3(0.4, 0.08, 0.1)), Color(0.4, 0.15, 0.05), Vector3(x * 0.38, 2.12, -0.92), Vector3.ONE, Vector3(0, 0, x * 0.4))
	_mouth(body, Vector3(0, 1.2, -1.0), 0.9)
	for i in 4:
		_m(G.cyl(0.0, 0.07, 0.18, 4), Color.WHITE, Vector3(-0.3 + i * 0.2, 1.38, -1.0), Vector3.ONE, Vector3(PI, 0, 0))

func center() -> Vector3:
	return global_position + Vector3(0, head_h * 0.55, 0)

func bark(id: String, force := false) -> void:
	if not alive and not id.contains("die"):
		return
	if not force and (bark_id != "" or not main.can_bark()):
		return
	main.barked()
	bark_id = id
	bark_t = 0.0
	bark_len = float(G.line(id).dur)
	bubble.text = G.line(id).text
	bubble.visible = true
	if not G.headless:
		voice.stream = G.voice_stream(id)
		voice.play()

func _bark_kind(what: String) -> void:
	var pre: String = {"grubbo": "grub", "spitzer": "spit", "bonkhead": "bonk"}[kind]
	var opts: Array = []
	for k in G.lines.keys():
		if (k as String).begins_with(pre + "_" + what):
			opts.append(k)
	if not opts.is_empty():
		bark(G.pick(opts), what == "die")

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if bark_id != "":
		bark_t += delta
		if mouth:
			mouth.scale.y = mouth.scale.x * (0.12 + G.mouth_at(bark_id, bark_t) * 0.8)
		if bark_t > bark_len + 0.6:
			bark_id = ""
			bubble.visible = false
			if mouth:
				mouth.scale.y = mouth.scale.x * 0.15
	if flash > 0.0:
		flash -= delta
		if flash <= 0.0:
			for m in meshes:
				m.material_overlay = null

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not alive:
		return
	if spawn_t > 0.0:
		spawn_t -= delta
		var s := clampf(1.0 - spawn_t / 0.7, 0.01, 1.0)
		body.scale = Vector3.ONE * (s + sin(s * PI) * 0.3)
		return
	body.scale = body.scale.lerp(Vector3.ONE, minf(1.0, delta * 10.0))
	var to_p := player.global_position - global_position
	to_p.y = 0
	var dist := to_p.length()
	var dirp := to_p / maxf(dist, 0.01)
	var want := Vector3.ZERO
	attack_cd -= delta
	state_t -= delta
	if not spotted and dist < 32.0:
		spotted = true
		if G.rng.randf() < 0.7:
			_bark_kind("spot")
	taunt_t -= delta
	if taunt_t < 0.0:
		taunt_t = G.rng.randf_range(8.0, 16.0)
		if spotted and G.rng.randf() < 0.4:
			_bark_kind("taunt")
	var face_dir := dirp
	var plive: bool = player.alive and player.controls
	match kind:
		"grubbo":
			if dist > 1.4:
				want = dirp * speed
			hop_t -= delta
			if is_on_floor() and hop_t <= 0.0:
				hop_t = G.rng.randf_range(0.5, 0.9)
				velocity.y = 5.0
				body.scale = Vector3(1.25, 0.75, 1.25)
			if dist < 1.8 and attack_cd <= 0.0 and plive:
				attack_cd = 1.0
				player.take_damage(9.0, global_position, 6.0)
				body.scale = Vector3(0.8, 1.3, 0.8)
		"spitzer":
			strafe_t -= delta
			if strafe_t <= 0.0:
				strafe_t = G.rng.randf_range(1.5, 3.0)
				strafe *= -1.0
			var side := Vector3(-dirp.z, 0, dirp.x) * strafe
			if dist > 16.0:
				want = dirp * speed
			elif dist < 9.0:
				want = -dirp * speed * 0.8 + side * 2.0
			else:
				want = side * speed * 0.6
			if attack_cd <= 0.0 and dist < 30.0 and plive:
				attack_cd = G.rng.randf_range(1.8, 2.6)
				var from := global_position + Vector3(0, 2.1, 0) + dirp * 0.7
				var target: Vector3 = player.global_position + Vector3(0, 1.2, 0) + player.velocity * 0.35
				var v := (target - from).normalized() * 17.0
				v.y += 1.5
				main.spawn_proj("spit", from, v, self)
				G.sfx3d("spit", from, main)
				body.scale = Vector3(0.85, 1.15, 0.85)
		"bonkhead":
			match state:
				"chase":
					if dist > 2.4:
						want = dirp * speed
					if dist < 2.8 and attack_cd <= 0.0 and plive:
						attack_cd = 1.4
						player.take_damage(16.0, global_position, 12.0)
						body.scale = Vector3(1.2, 0.85, 1.2)
					elif dist < 16.0 and dist > 5.0 and attack_cd <= 0.0 and plive:
						state = "windup"
						state_t = 0.8
						charge_dir = dirp
						if G.rng.randf() < 0.5:
							_bark_kind("spot")
				"windup":
					charge_dir = dirp
					body.position.x = sin(state_t * 60.0) * 0.08
					if state_t <= 0.0:
						state = "charge"
						state_t = 1.1
						body.position.x = 0
						G.sfx3d("roar", global_position, main, -4)
				"charge":
					want = charge_dir * 18.0
					face_dir = charge_dir
					if dist < 2.6 and plive:
						player.take_damage(24.0, global_position, 18.0)
						state = "rest"
						state_t = 1.0
						attack_cd = 2.0
					elif state_t <= 0.0 or (is_on_wall() and state_t < 0.95):
						if is_on_wall():
							main.fx.puff(global_position + Vector3(0, 1.5, 0) + charge_dir, Color(1, 1, 0.6), 8)
							G.sfx3d("land", global_position, main, 4)
							state_t = 1.8
						else:
							state_t = 0.9
						state = "rest"
						attack_cd = 2.0
				"rest":
					body.rotation.z = sin(state_t * 8.0) * 0.06
					if state_t <= 0.0:
						state = "chase"
						body.rotation.z = 0
	# don't pile up on each other
	var sep := Vector3.ZERO
	for e in main.enemies:
		if e == self or not is_instance_valid(e):
			continue
		var d: Vector3 = global_position - e.global_position
		d.y = 0
		var l := d.length()
		var min_d: float = radius + e.radius
		if l < min_d and l > 0.001:
			sep += d / l * (min_d - l) * 6.0
	if dist < radius + 0.5:
		sep -= dirp * 4.0
	knock = knock.move_toward(Vector3.ZERO, delta * 25.0)
	var target_v := want + sep + Vector3(knock.x, 0, knock.z)
	var acc := 10.0 if is_on_floor() else 3.0
	velocity.x = lerpf(velocity.x, target_v.x, minf(1.0, acc * delta))
	velocity.z = lerpf(velocity.z, target_v.z, minf(1.0, acc * delta))
	if knock.y > 0.0 and is_on_floor():
		velocity.y = knock.y
		knock.y = 0
	velocity.y -= GRAVITY * delta
	move_and_slide()
	if face_dir.length() > 0.1:
		var yaw := atan2(-face_dir.x, -face_dir.z)
		rotation.y = lerp_angle(rotation.y, yaw, minf(1.0, delta * 8.0))
	if global_position.y < -20.0:
		hurt(9999.0, global_position)

func hurt(dmg: float, at: Vector3, push := Vector3.ZERO) -> bool:
	if not alive or spawn_t > 0.0:
		return false
	hp -= dmg
	flash = 0.07
	for m in meshes:
		m.material_overlay = hurt_mat
	knock += push * (0.25 if big else 1.0)
	main.fx.number(at, dmg)
	main.fx.puff(at, Color(0.5, 1.0, 0.3) if kind == "grubbo" else (Color(0.8, 0.4, 1.0) if kind == "spitzer" else Color(1.0, 0.6, 0.2)), 2)
	if not spotted:
		spotted = true
	if hp <= 0.0:
		_die()
		return true
	if G.rng.randf() < 0.1:
		_bark_kind("hit")
	return false

func _die() -> void:
	alive = false
	collision_layer = 0
	if G.rng.randf() < 0.55:
		_bark_kind("die")
	G.sfx3d("die", global_position + Vector3(0, 1, 0), main, 2)
	var c: Color = {"grubbo": Color(0.5, 1, 0.3), "spitzer": Color(0.75, 0.4, 1), "bonkhead": Color(1, 0.6, 0.2)}[kind]
	main.fx.burst(global_position + Vector3(0, head_h * 0.6, 0), c, 1.6 if big else 1.0)
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_property(body, "scale", Vector3(1.4, 0.2, 1.4), 0.25).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK)
	tw.tween_property(body, "scale", Vector3(0.01, 0.01, 0.01), 0.25)
	if big or G.rng.randf() < 0.3:
		main.spawn_health(global_position + Vector3(0, 0.6, 0))
	died.emit(self)
	get_tree().create_timer(maxf(1.0, bark_len + 0.7)).timeout.connect(queue_free)

var slam_t := 0.0

		var a := TAU * i / 7.0
		G.part(crown, G.cyl(0.0, 0.3, 0.9, 6), gold, Vector3(cos(a) * 1.35, 0.8, sin(a) * 1.35))
		G.part(crown, G.sphere(0.16, 8), G.mat(Color(0.3, 0.9, 1.0), 1.0), Vector3(cos(a) * 1.45, 0.1, sin(a) * 1.45))
	G.part(self, G.cyl(4.0, 4.0, 0.02, 24), G.flat(Color(0, 0, 0, 0.3)), Vector3(0, 0.05, 0))
	hurt_mat = G.flat(Color(1, 1, 1, 0.5))
	home = global_position

func center() -> Vector3:
	return global_position + Vector3(0, 3.4, 0)

func say(id: String) -> void:
	# boss lines go through the main dialogue (subtitles), played from his body in 3D
	Talk.say(id, 2 if not id.begins_with("glorp_intro") else 3)

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	var m := Talk.mouth("GLORP")
	mouth.scale.y = lerpf(mouth.scale.y, 0.4 + m * 2.2, minf(1.0, delta * 20.0))
	wob += delta
	var squish := sin(wob * 3.0) * 0.04
	jelly.scale = Vector3(1.1 + squish, 0.95 - squish, 1.0 + squish)
	crown.rotation.z = sin(wob * 2.3) * (0.05 + (phase - 1) * 0.06)
	if flash > 0.0:
		flash -= delta
		if flash <= 0.0:
			for mi in meshes:
				mi.material_overlay = null

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not alive:
		return
	invuln -= delta
	var to_p := player.global_position - global_position
	to_p.y = 0
	var dist := to_p.length()
	var dirp := to_p / maxf(dist, 0.01)
	rotation.y = lerp_angle(rotation.y, atan2(-dirp.x, -dirp.z), minf(1.0, delta * 2.0))
	var want := Vector3.ZERO
	if active and slam_state == "":
		if dist > 18.0:
			want = dirp * (3.0 + phase)
		elif dist < 10.0:
			want = -dirp * 2.5
		# don't drift too far from the arena center
		var off := global_position - home
		off.y = 0
		if off.length() > 14.0:
			want = -off.normalized() * 4.0
		attack_t -= delta
		if attack_t <= 0.0:
			_attack()
		taunt_t -= delta
		if taunt_t <= 0.0:
			taunt_t = G.rng.randf_range(14.0, 22.0)
			if not Talk.busy():
				say("glorp_taunt1")
	if slam_state != "":
		_slam(delta)
		return
	velocity.x = lerpf(velocity.x, want.x, minf(1.0, delta * 3.0))
	velocity.z = lerpf(velocity.z, want.z, minf(1.0, delta * 3.0))
	velocity.y -= GRAVITY * delta
	move_and_slide()

func _attack() -> void:
	var pattern := ["rain", "slam", "rain"] if phase == 1 else (["rain", "summon", "slam", "rain"] if phase == 2 else ["slam", "rain", "summon", "rain", "slam"])
	var a: String = pattern[attack_i % pattern.size()]
	attack_i += 1
	main._log("boss attack " + a)
	match a:
		"rain":
			attack_t = 3.6 - phase * 0.5
			var n := 4 + phase * 3
			for i in n:
				var spot: Vector3 = player.global_position
				if i > 0:
					var ang := G.rng.randf() * TAU
					spot += Vector3(cos(ang), 0, sin(ang)) * G.rng.randf_range(2.0, 9.0)
				spot.y = 0.05
				var from := global_position + Vector3(G.rng.randf_range(-1.5, 1.5), 7.0, G.rng.randf_range(-1.5, 1.5))
				var t := 1.3 + G.rng.randf() * 0.6
				var g := 16.0
				var v := (spot - from) / t
				v.y = (spot.y - from.y + 0.5 * g * t * t) / t
				main.spawn_proj("glob", from, v, self, spot)
			G.sfx3d("spit", global_position + Vector3(0, 6, 0), main, 6)
			body.scale = Vector3(0.9, 1.15, 0.9)
			create_tween().tween_property(body, "scale", Vector3.ONE, 0.4)
		"slam":
			attack_t = 4.5 - phase * 0.4
			slam_state = "up"
			slam_t = 0.0
			velocity = Vector3(0, 14.0, 0)
			if G.rng.randf() < 0.6 and not Talk.busy():
				say(G.pick(["glorp_slam1", "glorp_slam2"]))
		"summon":
			attack_t = 3.0
			for i in (2 if phase == 2 else 3):
				var ang := G.rng.randf() * TAU
				var at := global_position + Vector3(cos(ang), 0, sin(ang)) * 7.0
				main.spawn_alien("grubbo", at)
			if phase == 3:
				main.spawn_alien("spitzer", global_position + Vector3(0, 0, 8).rotated(Vector3.UP, G.rng.randf() * TAU))

func _slam(delta: float) -> void:
	slam_t += delta
	if slam_state == "up":
		var to_p: Vector3 = player.global_position - global_position
		to_p.y = 0
		velocity.x = to_p.x * 0.6
		velocity.z = to_p.z * 0.6
		velocity.y -= GRAVITY * delta * 0.7
		if slam_t > 0.55:
			slam_state = "down"
			velocity = Vector3(0, -30.0, 0)
	elif slam_state == "down":
		velocity.y = -30.0
		if is_on_floor() or slam_t > 2.5:
			slam_state = ""
			velocity = Vector3.ZERO
			G.sfx("slam", 4)
			player.shake = 1.0
			body.scale = Vector3(1.3, 0.6, 1.3)
			create_tween().tween_property(body, "scale", Vector3.ONE, 0.5).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_ELASTIC)
			main.spawn_shockwave(global_position, 3 if phase == 3 else (2 if phase == 2 else 1))
	move_and_slide()

func hurt(dmg: float, at: Vector3, push := Vector3.ZERO) -> bool:
	if not alive or not active or invuln > 0.0:
		return false
	hp -= dmg
	flash = 0.06
	for mi in meshes:
		mi.material_overlay = hurt_mat
	main.fx.number(at, dmg)
	main.fx.puff(at, Color(1.0, 0.5, 0.7), 2)
	hurt_said -= dmg
	if hurt_said < -400.0 and not Talk.busy():
		hurt_said = 0.0
		say("glorp_hurt1")
	if phase == 1 and hp < max_hp * 0.66:
		_phase(2, "glorp_phase2")
	elif phase == 2 and hp < max_hp * 0.33:
		_phase(3, "glorp_phase3")
	if hp <= 0.0:
		hp = 0.0
		_die()
		return true
	return false

func _phase(p: int, line: String) -> void:
	main._log("boss phase %d" % p)
	phase = p
	invuln = 1.5
	attack_t = 2.0
	Talk.clear()
	Talk.say(line, 2)
	main.fx.burst(global_position + Vector3(0, 4, 0), Color(1, 0.4, 0.7), 2.5)
	G.sfx("explode", 2)
	var c := Color(0.95, 0.35, 0.6, 0.88).lerp(Color(1.0, 0.15, 0.25, 0.9), (p - 1) * 0.5)
	jelly.material_override = G.mat(c, 0.25)

func _die() -> void:
	alive = false
	active = false
	collision_layer = 0
	Talk.clear()
	Talk.say("glorp_die", 3)
	died.emit(self)
	var tw := create_tween()
	for i in 6:
		tw.tween_callback(func():
			main.fx.burst(global_position + Vector3(G.rng.randf_range(-3, 3), G.rng.randf_range(1, 6), G.rng.randf_range(-3, 3)), Color(1, 0.4, 0.7), 2.0)
			G.sfx("explode", 0))
		tw.tween_interval(0.45)
	tw.tween_property(body, "scale", Vector3(1.6, 0.1, 1.6), 0.6).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK)
	tw.tween_callback(func():
		main.fx.burst(global_position + Vector3(0, 2, 0), Color(1, 0.5, 0.8), 5.0)
		G.sfx("explode", 4)
		body.visible = false)

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	var m := Talk.mouth(who)
	var talking := Talk.cur_who == who
	mouth.scale.y = lerpf(mouth.scale.y, 0.12 + m * 0.9, minf(1.0, delta * 25.0))
	# turn toward the player while talking, like it's looking at you
	talk_turn = lerpf(talk_turn, 1.0 if talking else 0.0, minf(1.0, delta * 5.0))
	rotation.y = talk_turn * 0.3
	rotation.z = talk_turn * sin(Time.get_ticks_msec() * 0.006) * 0.04
	# blink
	blink_t -= delta
	var blink := 1.0
	if blink_t < 0.12:
		blink = 0.1
	if blink_t < 0.0:
		blink_t = G.rng.randf_range(1.8, 4.5)
	for w in whites:
		w.scale.y = lerpf(w.scale.y, blink, minf(1.0, delta * 30.0))
	# eyes wander when quiet, look straight at you when talking
	look_t -= delta
	if look_t < 0.0:
		look_t = G.rng.randf_range(0.6, 2.0)
		look = Vector2(G.rng.randf_range(-1, 1), G.rng.randf_range(-0.6, 0.6))
	var target := Vector2.ZERO if talking else look
	for p in pupils:
		var r: float = (p.get_parent() as MeshInstance3D).mesh.radius
		p.position.x = lerpf(p.position.x, target.x * r * 0.35, minf(1.0, delta * 8.0))
		p.position.y = lerpf(p.position.y, target.y * r * 0.35, minf(1.0, delta * 8.0))
	for i in brows.size():
		brows[i].position.y = 0.07 + mood * 0.01
		brows[i].rotation.z = (0.35 - mood * 0.3) * (1.0 if i == 0 else -1.0)
	barrels.rotation.z += spin_speed * delta

func _btn_at(p: Vector2) -> String:
	for n in buttons:
		var b: Panel = buttons[n].node
		var r: float = buttons[n].r
		if p.distance_to(b.global_position + Vector2(r, r)) < r * 1.15:
			return n
	return ""

func _input(e: InputEvent) -> void:
	if e is InputEventScreenTouch or e is InputEventScreenDrag:
		if not G.touch_mode:
			G.touch_mode = true
	if not G.touch_mode or not main.playing() or player == null:
		return
	# Touch positions arrive in window pixels; convert to the stretched canvas.
	var xf := root.get_viewport().get_final_transform().affine_inverse()
	if e is InputEventScreenTouch:
		var p: Vector2 = xf * e.position
		if e.pressed:
			if p.y < 220 and Talk.story_busy():
				Talk.skip_story()
				return
			var b := _btn_at(p)
			var vw := root.size.x
			if b == "fire":
				fire_idx = e.index
				player.touch_fire = true
			elif b == "alt":
				player.do_alt()
			elif b == "jump":
				player.do_jump()
			elif b == "dash":
				player.do_dash()
			elif b == "swap":
				player.swap_to(1 - player.cur)
			elif p.x < vw * 0.4 and stick_idx < 0:
				stick_idx = e.index
				stick_origin = p
				stick_base.visible = true
				stick_knob.visible = true
				stick_base.position = p - stick_base.size * 0.5
				stick_knob.position = p - stick_knob.size * 0.5
			elif look_idx < 0:
				look_idx = e.index
		else:
			if e.index == stick_idx:
				stick_idx = -1
				player.touch_move = Vector2.ZERO
				stick_base.visible = false
				stick_knob.visible = false
			if e.index == look_idx:
				look_idx = -1
			if e.index == fire_idx:
				fire_idx = -1
				player.touch_fire = false
	elif e is InputEventScreenDrag:
		var p: Vector2 = xf * e.position
		var rel: Vector2 = xf.basis_xform(e.relative)
		if e.index == stick_idx:
			var d := (p - stick_origin).limit_length(70.0)
			player.touch_move = d / 70.0
			stick_knob.position = stick_origin + d - stick_knob.size * 0.5
		elif e.index == look_idx or e.index == fire_idx:
			player.touch_look += rel * 0.006

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	hit_t = maxf(0.0, hit_t - delta)
	vignette.color.a = maxf(0.0, vignette.color.a - delta * 1.2)
	sub_t -= delta
	if sub_t < 0.0 and sub_panel.visible:
		sub_panel.modulate.a -= delta * 3.0
		if sub_panel.modulate.a <= 0.0:
			sub_panel.visible = false
	skip_hint.text = "Enter / tap to skip talking" if Talk.story_busy() and main.playing() else ""
	var show_hud: bool = main.playing() or main.state == "dead"
	cross.visible = main.playing()
	touch.visible = G.touch_mode and main.playing()
	for n in [hp_fill.get_parent(), gun_name.get_parent(), objective]:
		n.visible = show_hud
	if player == null:
		return
	var f: float = player.hp / player.max_hp
	hp_fill.size.x = 292.0 * f
	hp_fill.color = Color(0.35, 1.0, 0.45) if f > 0.35 else Color(1.0, 0.3 + sin(Time.get_ticks_msec() * 0.01) * 0.2, 0.3)
	hp_label.text = "%d HP" % int(ceil(player.hp))
	if player.cur == 0:
		gun_name.text = "GATLION"
		gun_name.add_theme_color_override("font_color", G.SPEAKER_COLOR.GATLION)
		gun_fill.size.x = 314.0 * player.heat
		gun_fill.color = Color(1, 0.25, 0.15) if player.overheated else Color(1, 0.6, 0.2).lerp(Color(1, 0.2, 0.1), player.heat)

		alt_label.text = "ROAR: READY" if player.gat_alt_cd <= 0.0 else "ROAR: %d" % int(ceil(player.gat_alt_cd))
	else:
		gun_name.text = "SQUIBBY"
		gun_name.add_theme_color_override("font_color", G.SPEAKER_COLOR.SQUIBBY)
		var r: float = (1.0 - player.reload_t / 1.2) if player.reload_t > 0.0 else float(player.clip) / player.CLIP
		gun_fill.size.x = 314.0 * r
		gun_fill.color = Color(0.3, 1.0, 0.7)
		gun_info.text = "RELOADING..." if player.reload_t > 0.0 else "GOO %d / %d" % [player.clip, player.CLIP]
		alt_label.text = "GOO BOMB: READY" if player.squ_alt_cd <= 0.0 else "GOO BOMB: %d" % int(ceil(player.squ_alt_cd))

func _solid(pos: Vector3, size: Vector3, c: Color, mesh: Mesh = null, rot := Vector3.ZERO) -> StaticBody3D:
	var sb := StaticBody3D.new()
	sb.collision_layer = G.LAYER_WORLD
	sb.collision_mask = 0
	sb.position = pos
	sb.rotation = rot
	world.add_child(sb)
	var cs := CollisionShape3D.new()
	var bs := BoxShape3D.new()
	bs.size = size
	cs.shape = bs
	sb.add_child(cs)
	if mesh:
		G.part(sb, mesh, G.mat(c, 0.0, true))
	else:
		G.part(sb, G.box(size), G.mat(c, 0.0, true))
	return sb

func _cyl_solid(pos: Vector3, r: float, h: float, c: Color, top := -1.0, glow := 0.0) -> void:
	var sb := StaticBody3D.new()
	sb.collision_layer = G.LAYER_WORLD
	sb.collision_mask = 0
	sb.position = pos
	world.add_child(sb)
	var cs := CollisionShape3D.new()
	var shape := CylinderShape3D.new()
	shape.radius = r
	shape.height = h
	cs.shape = shape
	cs.position.y = h * 0.5
	sb.add_child(cs)
	G.part(sb, G.cyl(r if top < 0 else top, r, h, 7 if top == 0.0 else 12), G.mat(c, glow, true), Vector3(0, h * 0.5, 0))

func _mushroom(pos: Vector3, s: float, cap: Color) -> void:
	_cyl_solid(pos, 0.35 * s, 2.2 * s, Color(0.95, 0.9, 0.75))
	var n := Node3D.new()
	n.position = pos + Vector3(0, 2.2 * s, 0)
	world.add_child(n)
	G.part(n, G.sphere(1.0, 16), G.mat(cap, 0.15, true), Vector3.ZERO, Vector3(1.6, 0.8, 1.6) * s)
	for i in 4:
		var a := TAU * i / 4.0 + 0.4
		G.part(n, G.sphere(0.18 * s, 8), G.flat(Color(1, 1, 0.85)), Vector3(cos(a) * 0.9 * s, 0.45 * s, sin(a) * 0.9 * s))

func _crystal(pos: Vector3, h: float, c: Color) -> void:
	_cyl_solid(pos, h * 0.22, h, c, 0.0, 0.6)
	G.part(world, G.cyl(0.0, h * 0.12, h * 0.6, 6), G.mat(c.lightened(0.2), 0.8, true), pos + Vector3(h * 0.3, h * 0.3, 0.2), Vector3.ONE, Vector3(0, 0, -0.5))

func _tree(pos: Vector3, c: Color) -> void:
	_cyl_solid(pos, 0.4, 5.0, Color(0.45, 0.25, 0.5))
	for i in 3:
		G.part(world, G.sphere(1.6 - i * 0.3, 12), G.mat(c, 0.1, true), pos + Vector3(G.rng.randf_range(-0.6, 0.6), 5.2 + i * 1.1, G.rng.randf_range(-0.6, 0.6)))

func _ground(z0: float, z1: float, c: Color) -> void:
	G.part(world, G.box(Vector3(56, 0.1, absf(z1 - z0))), G.mat(c), Vector3(0, -0.04, (z0 + z1) * 0.5))

func _gate(z: float) -> Dictionary:

	sb.collision_layer = G.LAYER_WORLD
	sb.position = Vector3(0, 6, z)
	world.add_child(sb)

	cs.shape = bs
	sb.add_child(cs)
	var m := G.part(sb, G.box(Vector3(54, 12, 0.15)), G.flat(Color(0.3, 0.95, 1.0, 0.28)))

		G.part(world, G.cyl(0.8, 1.0, 13, 10), G.mat(Color(0.3, 0.3, 0.45), 0.0, true), Vector3(x, 6.5, z))

func set_gate(i: int, open: bool) -> void:
	var g: Dictionary = gates[i]
	if g.open == open:
		return
	g.open = open
	g.shape.set_deferred("disabled", open)
	g.body.visible = not open
	if open:
		G.sfx("field", 0)

# ---------------- flow ----------------
func start() -> void:
	if state != "title":
		return
	state = "intro"
	hud.title.visible = false
	player.rotation.y = -0.4  # look at Zib
	player.controls = true
	_capture()
	set_gate(0, false)
	hud.set_objective("Talk to Zib at the Bounty Office")
	Talk.seq(["zib_intro1", "zib_intro2", "gat_intro1", "squ_intro1", "gat_intro2", "zib_intro3"], 3)

func _capture() -> void:
	if not G.touch_mode and not G.headless:
		Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED
	pause_grace = 0.6

func resume() -> void:
	hud.pause.visible = false
	get_tree().paused = false
	_capture()

func _intro_done() -> void:
	state = "play"
	set_gate(0, true)
	hud.set_objective("Go through the force field into the Goo Swamp")
	hud.message("GO!", "Head to the Goo Swamp", 1.5)

func _log(t: String) -> void:
	if G.selftest:
		print("[%.0fs] %s" % [play_time, t])

func _enter_area(i: int) -> void:
	_log("enter area %d" % i)
	area = i
	area_cleared = false
	wave = -1
	wave_t = 2.5
	set_gate(i, false)
	var a: Dictionary = AREAS[i]
	hud.message(a.name, "", 2.0)
	Talk.seq(a.lines, 2)
	if i == 2:
		G.music("music_boss")
		_spawn_boss()
		hud.set_objective("Defeat Kingpin Glorp!")
	else:
		G.music("music_fight")
		hud.set_objective("Clear the %s" % a.name.capitalize())

func _area_clear() -> void:
	area_cleared = true
	set_gate(area + 1, true)
	hud.message("AREA CLEAR!", "The force field is down", 2.0)
	Talk.say("gat_clear" if G.rng.randf() < 0.5 else "squ_clear", 2)
	G.music("music_hub")
	hud.set_objective("Go through the force field into the %s" % AREAS[area + 1].name.capitalize())

func _next_wave() -> void:
	wave += 1
	_log("wave %d" % wave)
	var waves: Array = AREAS[area].waves
	if wave >= waves.size():
		_area_clear()
		return
	G.sfx("alarm", -2)
	hud.message("WAVE %d / %d" % [wave + 1, waves.size()], "", 1.2)
	if wave > 0:
		Talk.chatter(["gat_wave1", "gat_wave2", "squ_wave1", "squ_wave2"])
	var center := Vector3(0, 0, GATES[area] - 38.0)
	var kinds: Array = waves[wave]
	for k in kinds:
		var p := center + Vector3(G.rng.randf_range(-20, 20), 0.5, G.rng.randf_range(-16, 14))
		spawn_queue.append({"kind": KINDS[k], "pos": p})
	spawn_t = 0.3

func spawn_alien(kind: String, pos: Vector3) -> Node:
	var a := CharacterBody3D.new()
	a.set_script(load("res://scripts/alien.gd"))
	a.main = self
	a.player = player
	add_child(a)
	a.setup(kind)
	a.global_position = pos
	a.rotation.y = G.rng.randf() * TAU
	a.died.connect(_on_alien_died)
	enemies.append(a)

func _spawn_boss() -> void:
	boss = CharacterBody3D.new()
	boss.set_script(load("res://scripts/boss.gd"))
	boss.main = self
	boss.player = player
	add_child(boss)
	boss.global_position = Vector3(0, 0.5, -182)
	boss.setup()
	boss.died.connect(_on_boss_died)
	Talk.seq(["glorp_intro1", "glorp_intro2", "gat_vsglorp"], 3)

func _on_alien_died(a: Node) -> void:
	enemies.erase(a)

func _on_boss_died(_b: Node) -> void:
	_log("boss died")
	win_t = 4.0
	for e in enemies.duplicate():
		if is_instance_valid(e) and e.alive:
			e.hurt(9999.0, e.global_position)
	hud.set_objective("")
	G.music_stop()

func _on_player_died() -> void:
	state = "dead"
	dead_t = 3.0
	hud.message("SPLAT!", "Respawning...", 2.0)
	player.controls = false

func _respawn() -> void:
	_log("respawn")
	for e in enemies.duplicate():
		if is_instance_valid(e):
			e.queue_free()
	enemies.clear()
	spawn_queue.clear()
	for n in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("proj"):
		n._remove()
	for r in waves_rings:
		r.node.queue_free()
	waves_rings.clear()
	var at: Vector3 = Vector3(0, 0.2, 10) if area < 0 else AREAS[area].check
	player.respawn(at, 0.0)
	if area >= 0 and not area_cleared and area < 2:
		wave = -1
		wave_t = 2.0
	if area == 2 and is_instance_valid(boss) and boss.alive:
		var floor_hp: float = boss.max_hp * (1.0 if boss.phase == 1 else (0.66 if boss.phase == 2 else 0.33))
		boss.hp = maxf(boss.hp, floor_hp - 1.0)
		boss.global_position = Vector3(0, 0.5, -182)
		boss.attack_t = 4.0
	state = "play"
	player.controls = true
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_property(hud.fade, "color:a", 0.0, 0.5)

func targets() -> Array:
	var out: Array = []
	for e in enemies:
		if is_instance_valid(e) and e.alive:
			out.append(e)
	if is_instance_valid(boss) and boss.alive and boss.active:
		out.append(boss)
	return out

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	bark_cd -= delta
	# Zib's mouth + bobbing
	if zib_mouth:
		zib_mouth.scale.y = lerpf(zib_mouth.scale.y, 0.2 + Talk.mouth("ZIB") * 1.2, minf(1.0, delta * 20.0))
		zib_body.position.y = sin(Time.get_ticks_msec() * 0.003) * 0.06
		var d: Vector3 = player.global_position - zib_body.global_position
		zib_body.rotation.y = lerp_angle(zib_body.rotation.y, atan2(d.x, d.z), minf(1.0, delta * 3.0))
	if state == "title":
		title_spin += delta * 0.08
		player.rotation.y = sin(title_spin) * 0.5 + 0.3
		return
	if playing():
		play_time += delta
		# desktop: losing the mouse (Esc / alt-tab) pauses the game
		pause_grace -= delta
		if not G.touch_mode and not G.headless and not G.autoplay and pause_grace <= 0.0 and Input.mouse_mode != Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED and not get_tree().paused:
			get_tree().paused = true
			hud.pause.visible = true
	if state == "intro" and not Talk.story_busy():
		_intro_done()
	if state == "dead":
		dead_t -= delta
		hud.fade.color.a = clampf(1.0 - (dead_t - 0.5) / 1.5, 0.0, 1.0)
		if dead_t <= 0.0:
			_respawn()
	if state == "play":
		# areas
		var z: float = player.global_position.z
		if area_cleared and area < 2 and z < GATES[area + 1] - 3.0:
			_enter_area(area + 1)

		if area >= 0 and area < 2 and not area_cleared:
			if spawn_queue.is_empty() and enemies.is_empty():
				wave_t -= delta
				if wave_t <= 0.0:
					wave_t = 2.5
					_next_wave()
		if not spawn_queue.is_empty():
			spawn_t -= delta
			if spawn_t <= 0.0:
				spawn_t = 0.35
				var s: Dictionary = spawn_queue.pop_front()
				spawn_alien(s.kind, s.pos)
		# boss wakes up once he's done talking
		if area == 2 and is_instance_valid(boss) and boss.alive and not boss.active and not Talk.story_busy():
			boss.active = true
			hud.message("FIGHT!", "Jump over his shockwaves!", 1.5)
		# idle banter when nothing is going on
		if enemies.is_empty() and not Talk.busy() and win_t < 0.0:
			quiet_t += delta
			if quiet_t > 14.0:
				quiet_t = 0.0
				Talk.seq(BANTER[banter_i % BANTER.size()], 2)
				banter_i += 1
		else:
			quiet_t = 0.0
		# win sequence
		if win_t >= 0.0 and not Talk.story_busy():
			win_t -= delta
			if win_t <= 0.0 and not win_said:
				win_said = true
				win_t = 0.5
				Talk.seq(["zib_win", "gat_win", "squ_win"], 3)
				G.sfx("win")
			elif win_t <= 0.0 and win_said:
				_win()
	# pickups
	for p in pickups.duplicate():
		var n: Node3D = p.node
		p.t -= delta
		n.rotation.y += delta * 2.0
		n.position.y = p.y + sin(p.t * 3.0) * 0.15
		if player.alive and n.global_position.distance_to(player.global_position + Vector3(0, 0.8, 0)) < 1.7 and player.hp < player.max_hp:

		if p.t <= 0.0:
			n.queue_free()
			pickups.erase(p)

		if not r.hit and r.r > 0.5 and absf(d - r.r) < 1.0 and player.global_position.y < 0.9:
			r.hit = true
			player.take_damage(20.0, r.c, 10.0)

			waves_rings.erase(r)

	var s := int(play_time) % 60

	if e.is_action_pressed("skip") and playing():
		Talk.skip_story()
	if e is InputEventMouseButton and e.pressed and playing() and not G.touch_mode and Input.mouse_mode != Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED and not get_tree().paused:
		_capture()
	if e is InputEventKey and e.pressed and e.keycode == KEY_ESCAPE and Input.mouse_mode == Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED:
		Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE

func _selftest(delta: float) -> void:
	test_t += delta
	if test_t > 900.0:
		print("SELFTEST FAIL: timeout in state=%s area=%d wave=%d" % [state, area, wave])
		get_tree().quit(1)
		return
	if state == "won":
		print("SELFTEST OK kills=%d time=%.0fs" % [player.kills, play_time])
		get_tree().quit(0)
		return
	if Talk.story_busy() and fmod(test_t, 3.0) < delta:
		Talk.skip_story()
	if state != "play":
		return
	# exercise both guns and their specials
	var gun := int(test_t / 5.0) % 2
	if player.cur != gun:
		player.swap_to(gun)
	Input.action_press("fire")
	if fmod(test_t, 7.0) < delta:
		player.do_alt()
	if fmod(test_t, 2.0) < delta:
		player.do_jump()
	# die once to test respawn
	if area == 0 and wave == 1 and not test_died:
		test_died = true
		player.take_damage(999.0, player.global_position)
		return
	player.hp = maxf(player.hp, 50.0)
	if area_cleared and area < 2:
		player.global_position = Vector3(0, 0.3, GATES[area + 1] - 5.0)
		return
	# aim at the closest target, finish it after a while so the AI also gets to act
	var t := targets()
	if not t.is_empty():
		var e: Node3D = t[0]
		var to: Vector3 = e.global_position + Vector3(0, 1, 0) - player.cam.global_position
		player.rotation.y = atan2(-to.x, -to.z)
		if e == boss:
			if fmod(test_t, 0.5) < delta:
				boss.hurt(120.0, boss.global_position)
		elif e.get("spawn_t") <= 0.0 and fmod(test_t, 1.5) < delta:
			e.hurt(45.0, e.global_position)

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not alive:

		velocity.z = move_toward(velocity.z, 0, delta * 20)
		velocity.y -= GRAVITY * delta

		return

		_look(touch_look)
		touch_look = Vector2.ZERO

	squ_alt_cd = maxf(0.0, squ_alt_cd - delta)
	swap_t = maxf(0.0, swap_t - delta)
	# --- Gatlion ---
	var gat_firing := cur == 0 and held and not overheated
	if gat_firing:

	hp = max_hp

	reload_t = 0.0

	squ_alt_cd = 0.0

var shooter: Node

var life := 4.0
var fuse := -1.0
var stuck: Node3D
var stuck_off := Vector3.ZERO
var marker: Node3D
var ball: MeshInstance3D

func setup(k: String, v: Vector3, from: Node, mark_at = null) -> void:
	kind = k
	vel = v
	shooter = from
	match kind:
		"spit":
			grav = 3.0
			ball = G.part(self, G.sphere(0.25, 10), G.mat(Color(0.85, 0.4, 1.0), 1.5))
		"glob":
			grav = 16.0
			ball = G.part(self, G.sphere(0.6, 12), G.mat(Color(0.5, 1.0, 0.3), 0.8, true))
			if mark_at != null:
				marker = Node3D.new()
				main.add_child(marker)
				marker.global_position = mark_at
				G.part(marker, G.torus(2.3, 2.6), G.flat(Color(1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.8)), Vector3.ZERO, Vector3(1, 0.2, 1))
				G.part(marker, G.cyl(2.3, 2.3, 0.02, 20), G.flat(Color(1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.25)))
		"bomb":
			grav = 14.0
			ball = G.part(self, G.sphere(0.22, 12), G.mat(Color(0.4, 1.0, 0.6), 1.2, true))

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if fuse >= 0.0:
		if is_instance_valid(stuck) and stuck.get("alive") != false:
			global_position = stuck.global_position + stuck_off
		fuse -= delta
		ball.scale = Vector3.ONE * (1.0 + sin(fuse * 40.0) * 0.25)
		if fuse < 0.0:
			_explode()

	if life <= 0.0:
		_remove()
		return
	vel.y -= grav * delta
	var from := global_position
	var to := from + vel * delta
	var mask := G.LAYER_WORLD | (G.LAYER_ENEMY if kind == "bomb" else 0)
	var q := PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.create(from, to, mask)

		var r := 0.9 if kind == "spit" else 1.4
		if _seg_dist(from, to, pc) < r and p.alive:

			_remove()

	if not hit.is_empty():
		global_position = hit.position
		if kind == "bomb":

			if hit.collider is CharacterBody3D:
				stuck = hit.collider

	var ab := b - a

func _explode() -> void:

"""Draws icon.png (Gatlion's face) with numpy and writes a PNG by hand (no PIL needed)."""
import os, zlib, struct
import numpy as np

	img[m, :3] = c

c = N / 2
for i in range(12):
	a = 2 * np.pi * i / 12
	disc(c + np.cos(a) * 82, c + np.sin(a) * 82, 34, (0.85, 0.36, 0.1))
disc(c, c, 92, (0.12, 0.03, 0.18))
disc(c, c, 86, (1.0, 0.7, 0.18))
for s in (-1, 1):
	disc(c + s * 32, c - 18, 24, (1, 1, 1))
	disc(c + s * 30, c - 14, 11, (0.08, 0.02, 0.1))
disc(c, c + 14, 12, (0.95, 0.5, 0.35))
m = (abs(x - c) < 34) & (y > c + 34) & (y < c + 52)
img[m, :3] = (0.3, 0.05, 0.08)

def png(path, a):
	h, w = a.shape[:2]
	raw = b"".join(b"\x00" + (np.clip(a[r], 0, 1) * 255).astype(np.uint8).tobytes() for r in range(h))
	def chunk(t, d): return struct.pack(">I", len(d)) + t + d + struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(t + d) & 0xffffffff)
	open(path, "wb").write(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n" + chunk(b"IHDR", struct.pack(">IIBBBBB", w, h, 8, 6, 0, 0, 0)) + chunk(b"IDAT", zlib.compress(raw, 9)) + chunk(b"IEND", b""))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Synthesizes every sound effect (wav) and the three music loops (ogg) for Gatlion's Galaxy. Needs numpy + ffmpeg."""
import os, wave, subprocess, tempfile
import numpy as np

SR = 22050
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
OUT = os.path.join(HERE, "..", "assets", "sfx")
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
rng = np.random.default_rng(11)


def t(sec):
	return np.arange(int(SR * sec)) / SR


def noise(sec):
	return rng.uniform(-1, 1, int(SR * sec))


def expd(sec, k):
	return np.exp(-t(sec) * k)


def sweep(f0, f1, sec, kind="sin"):
	tt = t(sec)
	f = f0 * (f1 / f0) ** (tt / sec)
	ph = 2 * np.pi * np.cumsum(f) / SR
	if kind == "sq":
		return np.sign(np.sin(ph))
	if kind == "saw":
		return 2 * ((ph / (2 * np.pi)) % 1.0) - 1
	return np.sin(ph)


def smooth(x, n):
	"""Cheap lowpass: moving average of n samples."""
	if n <= 1:
		return x
	return np.convolve(x, np.ones(n) / n, mode="same")


def fade(x, a=0.003, r=0.02):
	na, nr = int(a * SR), int(r * SR)
	x = x.copy()
	if na:
		x[:na] *= np.linspace(0, 1, na)
	if nr:
		x[-nr:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, nr)
	return x


def save(name, x, norm=0.9):
	x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)
	x = x / (np.max(np.abs(x)) or 1.0) * norm
	with wave.open(os.path.join(OUT, name + ".wav"), "wb") as w:
		w.setnchannels(1); w.setsampwidth(2); w.setframerate(SR)
		w.writeframes((x * 32767).astype(np.int16).tobytes())


def save_ogg(name, x, norm=0.8):
	x = x / (np.max(np.abs(x)) or 1.0) * norm
	with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".wav", delete=False) as f:
		tmp = f.name
	with wave.open(tmp, "wb") as w:
		w.setnchannels(1); w.setsampwidth(2); w.setframerate(SR)
		w.writeframes((x * 32767).astype(np.int16).tobytes())
	subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-loglevel", "error", "-i", tmp, "-c:a", "libvorbis", "-q:a", "3",
		os.path.join(OUT, name + ".ogg")], check=True)
	os.remove(tmp)


def mix(*parts):
	n = max(len(p) for p in parts)
	out = np.zeros(n)
	for p in parts:
		out[:len(p)] += p
	return out


# ---------------- effects ----------------
def make_effects():
	# Gatlion: punchy chunky shot
	s = 0.14
	shot = smooth(noise(s), 3) * expd(s, 40) + 0.8 * sweep(180, 60, s) * expd(s, 30)
	save("gat_shot", fade(np.tanh(shot * 2.5)))
	# spin-up whirr
	s = 0.45
	spin = sweep(60, 420, s, "saw") * 0.5 + smooth(noise(s), 6) * 0.4
	save("gat_spin", fade(spin * np.linspace(0.3, 1, len(spin)), r=0.05), 0.6)
	# overheat steam hiss
	s = 1.2
	steam = (noise(s) - smooth(noise(s), 8)) * expd(s, 2.2)
	save("gat_hot", fade(steam), 0.7)
	# Squibby: wet bloop
	s = 0.22
	bloop = sweep(900, 180, s) * expd(s, 14) + 0.25 * smooth(noise(s), 4) * expd(s, 40)
	save("squ_shot", fade(bloop))
	# reload: gloopy bubbles
	bub = np.zeros(int(SR * 0.9))
	for i, f in enumerate([300, 420, 360, 520, 460]):
		b = sweep(f, f * 1.8, 0.09) * expd(0.09, 25)
		o = int(i * 0.16 * SR)
		bub[o:o + len(b)] += b
	save("squ_reload", fade(bub))
	# roar blast: growly lion roar
	s = 0.9
	tt = t(s)
	growl = sweep(150, 70, s, "saw") * (0.6 + 0.4 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 28 * tt))
	roar = np.tanh((growl + smooth(noise(s), 5) * 0.8) * 2.0) * np.minimum(1, tt * 12) * np.exp(-tt * 2.6)
	save("roar", fade(roar, r=0.08))
	# goo bomb throw + explosion
	save("throw", fade(sweep(300, 900, 0.18) * expd(0.18, 8) * 0.6))
	s = 1.1
	boom = smooth(noise(s), 14) * expd(s, 4.5) * 1.5 + sweep(110, 35, s) * expd(s, 5)
	save("explode", fade(np.tanh(boom * 2.2), r=0.1))
	# enemy hit splat
	s = 0.12
	save("hit", fade(smooth(noise(s), 3) * expd(s, 45) + sweep(500, 250, s) * expd(s, 50) * 0.5), 0.7)
	# hit marker tick
	save("tick", fade(np.sin(2 * np.pi * 2400 * t(0.04)) * expd(0.04, 90)), 0.5)
	# enemy death squelch
	s = 0.5
	sq = sweep(400, 80, s, "sq") * 0.3 * expd(s, 6) + smooth(noise(s), 7) * expd(s, 9)
	save("die", fade(sq))
	# player hurt thud
	s = 0.3
	save("hurt", fade(sweep(160, 50, s) * expd(s, 12) + smooth(noise(s), 10) * expd(s, 25) * 0.6))
	# alien spit
	s = 0.25
	save("spit", fade(smooth(noise(s), 2) * expd(s, 18) * 0.6 + sweep(700, 300, s) * expd(s, 20) * 0.4), 0.7)
	# boss slam
	s = 1.4
	slam = sweep(80, 28, s) * expd(s, 3) * 1.4 + smooth(noise(s), 20) * expd(s, 5)
	save("slam", fade(np.tanh(slam * 2.5), r=0.1))
	# pickup chime
	ch = mix(*[np.pad(np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t(0.25)) * expd(0.25, 12), (int(i * 0.07 * SR), 0))
		for i, f in enumerate([880, 1175, 1568])])
	save("pickup", fade(ch), 0.6)
	# jump whoosh
	s = 0.25
	save("jump", fade((noise(s) - smooth(noise(s), 4)) * np.sin(np.pi * t(s) / s) * 0.5 + sweep(200, 420, s) * 0.2 * expd(s, 8)), 0.45)
	# land thump
	save("land", fade(sweep(120, 50, 0.12) * expd(0.12, 30)), 0.5)
	# force field down
	s = 1.0
	save("field", fade(sweep(1200, 80, s, "sq") * 0.25 * expd(s, 2) + sweep(600, 40, s) * expd(s, 2.5)), 0.6)
	# wave alarm
	al = np.concatenate([sweep(500, 900, 0.25, "sq"), sweep(500, 900, 0.25, "sq")]) * 0.3
	save("alarm", fade(al), 0.5)
	# ui click
	save("click", fade(np.sin(2 * np.pi * 900 * t(0.05)) * expd(0.05, 60)), 0.5)
	# empty clip click
	save("dry", fade(smooth(noise(0.03), 2) * expd(0.03, 120)), 0.4)
	# win fanfare
	fan = np.zeros(int(SR * 2.2))
	for i, f in enumerate([523, 659, 784, 1047]):
		n = sweep(f, f, 0.5, "sq") * 0.25 + np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t(0.5))
		n *= expd(0.5, 3 if i < 3 else 1.5)
		if i == 3:
			n = np.concatenate([n, np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t(1.0)) * np.linspace(1, 0, int(SR * 1.0))])
		o = int(i * 0.18 * SR)
		fan[o:o + len(n)] += n[:len(fan) - o]
	save("win", fade(fan, r=0.1), 0.7)


# ---------------- music ----------------
NOTE = {"C": 0, "C#": 1, "D": 2, "D#": 3, "E": 4, "F": 5, "F#": 6, "G": 7, "G#": 8, "A": 9, "A#": 10, "B": 11}


def hz(name, octave):
	return 440.0 * 2 ** ((NOTE[name] + 12 * (octave - 4) - 9) / 12)


def tone(f, sec, kind="saw", decay=6.0, vol=1.0):
	tt = t(sec)
	ph = 2 * np.pi * f * tt
	if kind == "saw":
		w = 2 * ((f * tt) % 1.0) - 1
	elif kind == "sq":
		w = np.sign(np.sin(ph)) * 0.6
	elif kind == "tri":
		w = 2 / np.pi * np.arcsin(np.sin(ph))
	else:
		w = np.sin(ph)
	return fade(w * np.exp(-tt * decay) * vol, 0.002, 0.01)


def kick():
	s = 0.3
	return sweep(140, 40, s) * expd(s, 14)


def snare():
	s = 0.2
	return smooth(noise(s), 2) * expd(s, 18) * 0.6 + np.sin(2 * np.pi * 190 * t(s)) * expd(s, 25) * 0.4


def hat():
	s = 0.05
	return (noise(s) - smooth(noise(s), 3)) * expd(s, 70) * 0.35


def song(bpm, bars, chords, bass_pat, drum_pat, lead=None, lead_kind="sq", bass_kind="saw", pad=True):
	beat = 60.0 / bpm
	step = beat / 4  # 16th notes
	total = int(bars * 16 * step * SR)
	out = np.zeros(total + SR)

	def put(x, at_step):
		o = int(at_step * step * SR)
		out[o:o + len(x)] += x[:len(out) - o]

	for bar in range(bars):
		root, oct_, minor = chords[bar % len(chords)]
		r = hz(root, oct_)
		third = r * (2 ** ((3 if minor else 4) / 12))
		fifth = r * 2 ** (7 / 12)
		base = bar * 16
		for i, ch in enumerate(bass_pat):
			if ch == "x":
				put(smooth(tone(r / 2, step * 1.8, bass_kind, 5, 0.55), 3), base + i)
			elif ch == "o":
				put(smooth(tone(r, step * 1.5, bass_kind, 7, 0.45), 3), base + i)
			elif ch == "5":
				put(smooth(tone(fifth / 2, step * 1.5, bass_kind, 7, 0.45), 3), base + i)
		for i, ch in enumerate(drum_pat):
			if ch in "kK":
				put(kick() * 0.9, base + i)
			if ch in "sS":
				put(snare() * 0.6, base + i)
			if ch in "hKS":
				put(hat(), base + i)
		if pad:
			for f in (r * 2, third * 2, fifth * 2):
				p = tone(f, step * 16, "tri", 0.4, 0.07)
				put(p, base)
		if lead:
			pat = lead[bar % len(lead)]
			for i, n in enumerate(pat):
				if n != ".":
					semis = int(n, 16)
					f = r * 4 * 2 ** (semis / 12)
					put(smooth(tone(f, step * 1.6, lead_kind, 8, 0.16), 2), base + i)
	out = out[:total]
	# loop seam: tiny crossfade
	n = int(0.01 * SR)
	out[:n] *= np.linspace(0, 1, n)
	out[-n:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, n)
	return np.tanh(out * 1.2)


def make_music():
	# hub: chill, funky
	hub = song(100, 8, [("A", 3, True), ("F", 3, False), ("C", 3, False), ("G", 3, False)],
		"x..o..x.5..o.x..", "k...s..hk.k.s..h",
		lead=["0...3...7...a.7.", "....5...3...0...", "7...a...c...a...", "5.....3...0....."], lead_kind="tri")
	save_ogg("music_hub", hub)
	# fight: upbeat alien funk
	fight = song(132, 8, [("E", 3, True), ("E", 3, True), ("C", 3, False), ("D", 3, False)],
		"x.ox.o5.x.ox.o5.", "K.h.S.h.K.hKS.hh",
		lead=["0.3.7.3.a.7.3.0.", "0.3.7.c.a.7.5.3.", "7...5...3...0...", "5.7.a.7.5.3.2.0."])
	save_ogg("music_fight", fight)
	# boss: heavy and dramatic
	boss = song(144, 8, [("D", 3, True), ("A#", 2, False), ("G", 2, True), ("A", 2, False)],
		"xxo.xxo.xxo.x5o5", "KhhhShhKKhhhShSS",
		lead=["0..3..7..c..a.7.", "0..3..5..7..5.3.", "c..a..7..5..3.0.", "1..4..7..a..d..."], bass_kind="sq")
	save_ogg("music_boss", boss)


if __name__ == "__main__":
	make_effects()
	make_music()
	print("\n".join(sorted(os.listdir(OUT))))

def speak(text, cfg):
	with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".wav", delete=False) as f:
		path = f.name
	subprocess.run(["espeak-ng", "-v", cfg["v"], "-s", str(cfg["s"]), "-p", str(cfg["p"]),
		"-w", path, text], check=True, capture_output=True)
	with wave.open(path) as w:
		sr = w.getframerate()
		x = np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()), dtype=np.int16).astype(np.float64) / 32768.0
	os.remove(path)
	if sr != SR:
		x = resample(x, sr / SR)
	return x


def resample(x, ratio):
	"""Play x at `ratio` times speed (ratio > 1 = higher and faster)."""
	n = int(len(x) / ratio)
	return np.interp(np.arange(n) * ratio, np.arange(len(x)), x)


def varispeed(x, rate_fn):
	"""Time-varying resample; rate_fn(t_out_seconds) -> playback rate."""
	pos = 0.0
	out = []
	t = 0.0
	while pos < len(x) - 1:
		out.append(pos)
		pos += rate_fn(t)
		t += 1.0 / SR
	pos = np.array(out)
	return np.interp(pos, np.arange(len(x)), x)


def comb(x, delay_s, fb):
	d = int(delay_s * SR)
	y = np.concatenate([x, np.zeros(d * 6)])
	for i in range(d, len(y), d):
		seg = y[i - d:i] * fb
		y[i:i + d][:len(seg)] += seg[:len(y[i:i + d])]
	return y


def echo(x, taps):
	n = len(x) + int(max(t for t, _ in taps) * SR) + 1
	y = np.zeros(n)
	y[:len(x)] += x
	for t, g in taps:
		o = int(t * SR)
		y[o:o + len(x)] += x * g
	return y


def onepole(x, cutoff):
	a = np.exp(-2 * np.pi * cutoff / SR)
	y = np.empty_like(x)
	p = 0.0
	for i in range(len(x)):
		p = (1 - a) * x[i] + a * p
		y[i] = p
	return y


def process(x, fx):
	t = np.arange(len(x)) / SR
	if fx == "gun":
		# a little lower, plus short metallic resonance (sounds like it lives inside a gun barrel)
		x = resample(x, 0.97)
		x = x + 0.35 * comb(x, 0.0042, 0.45)[:len(x)]
		x = np.tanh(x * 1.6)
	elif fx == "chipmunk":
		x = resample(x, 1.32)
	elif fx == "wobble":
		x = varispeed(x, lambda tt: 1.08 + 0.09 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 6.5 * tt))
		t = np.arange(len(x)) / SR
		x = x * (0.75 + 0.25 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 90 * t))  # light ring-mod = alien buzz
	elif fx == "bubble":
		x = varispeed(x, lambda tt: 1.45 + 0.18 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 11 * tt))
		t = np.arange(len(x)) / SR
		x = x * (0.6 + 0.4 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 140 * t))
	elif fx == "hiss":
		x = resample(x, 1.05)
		env = np.abs(x)
		env = np.convolve(env, np.ones(220) / 220, mode="same")
		hiss = rng.uniform(-1, 1, len(x))
		hiss = hiss - onepole(hiss, 2500)  # bright noise
		x = x * 1.4 + hiss * env * 1.2
	elif fx == "giant":
		x = resample(x, 0.72)
		x = onepole(x, 1800) * 1.6
		x = np.tanh(x * 1.4)
	elif fx == "boss":
		x = resample(x, 0.82)
		x = np.tanh(x * 3.0) * 0.6 + x * 0.5
		x = echo(x, [(0.11, 0.45), (0.23, 0.25), (0.37, 0.12)])
	return x


def save_ogg(name, x):
	x = np.asarray(x)
	x = x / (np.max(np.abs(x)) or 1.0) * 0.92
	# trim leading/trailing silence (keep 40 ms)
	idx = np.where(np.abs(x) > 0.02)[0]
	if len(idx):
		a = max(0, idx[0] - int(0.04 * SR)); b = min(len(x), idx[-1] + int(0.08 * SR))
		x = x[a:b]
	pcm = (x * 32767).astype(np.int16)
	with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".wav", delete=False) as f:
		tmp = f.name
	with wave.open(tmp, "wb") as w:
		w.setnchannels(1); w.setsampwidth(2); w.setframerate(SR); w.writeframes(pcm.tobytes())
	subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-loglevel", "error", "-i", tmp, "-c:a", "libvorbis", "-q:a", "3",
		os.path.join(OUT, name + ".ogg")], check=True)
	os.remove(tmp)
	# mouth envelope, 20 frames per second, 0..9
	hop = SR // 20
	envs = []
	for i in range(0, len(x), hop):
		envs.append(float(np.sqrt(np.mean(x[i:i + hop] ** 2))))
	m = max(envs) or 1.0
	env = "".join(str(min(9, int(e / m * 12))) for e in envs)
	return len(x) / SR, env


def main():
	meta = {}
	for lid, (who, text) in LINES.items():
		cfg = VOICES[who]
		x = process(speak(text, cfg), cfg["fx"])
		dur, env = save_ogg(lid, x)
		meta[lid] = {"who": who, "text": text, "dur": round(dur, 2), "env": env}
		print("%-14s %-9s %.2fs" % (lid, who, dur))
	json.dump(meta, open(os.path.join(OUT, "lines.json"), "w"), indent=0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
	main()
